trial_court: High Court of Jharkhand at Ranchi, Cr.M.P. No. 2051 of 2022
case_name: Manish Malhotra vs The State Of Jharkhand

parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Jharkhand, Puja Kaur @ Puja Malhotra, wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner is husband of complainant-Puja Kaur @ Puja Malhotra. She was subjected to cruelty and prima facie case was found against him. The marriage was dissolved by judgment and decree dated 5th July, 2022.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to annul a marriage to prove that the marriage was voidable.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted by learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the complainant was suffering from Epilepsy before solemnization of marriage and the marriage was solemnized suppressing this fact.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 — Clause C of Sub-section 2 of Section 5

outcome.final_order: The criminal proceeding arising out of C.P. Case No.2665 of 2021 is quashed.
